hero.copy: Diesel water pumps load-tested in our workshop, parts that fit the first time and an advisor who answers on WhatsApp.

benefits.intro: What you get when your pump leaves our workshop.

rows.p: Before shipping we run it under load in the workshop. It arrives at the mine ready to start.
Every part states which engine and pump it fits. You order the right one the first time.
When you buy, your unit is saved in your account with its serial, warranty and user guide.
You talk to someone who knows your unit, by WhatsApp or email. No switchboards, no waiting.

catalogs.title: Equipment and parts to keep your mine running

a.p: Every unit leaves our workshop load-tested. It reaches the mine ready to work.

b.p: At full load: steady flow to keep the work face dry, shift after shift.

c.p: Tap a part or its number: see its spare parts, prices and which units it fits.

d.p: Clear compatibility: you order the right part and the mine keeps going.
